workflowSummaryHelp: View benefit details, deadlines and evidence in Service fulfilment.
settingsHelp: The public profile and declared social tracking have separate responsibilities. Saving them does not publish the profile or authorize a social delivery.
profileHelp: Edit the profile address and summary. Its visibility is decided separately in the Website card.
declaredHelp: Keep references and notes for manual or historical tracking. A declared status does not confirm a delivered benefit or replace publication authorization.
saveHelp: Saves changed profile and declared tracking fields. Open the relevant publication to authorize a delivery.
